PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?italianWord ?sicilianWord
WHERE {
  # Step 1: Find the Sicilian translation(s) of 'mandria'
  ?mandriLemma ontolex:writtenRep ?mandriaWr .
  FILTER(STR(?mandriaWr) = "mandria")

  ?mandriLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?mandriLemma ;
                  vartrans:translatableAs ?mandriaSicLexEntry .
  ?mandriaSicLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?mandriaSicLemma .
  ?mandriaSicLemma dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/DialettoSiciliano/lemma/LemmaBank> ;
                   ontolex:writtenRep ?sicilianWord .

  # Step 2: Find other Sicilian lemmas with the same written form
  ?sicilianLemma dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/DialettoSiciliano/lemma/LemmaBank> ;
                 ontolex:writtenRep ?sicWr .
  FILTER(STR(?sicWr) = STR(?sicilianWord))

  # Step 3: Traverse back to Italian lexical entries that translate to those Sicilian lemmas
  ?sicLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?sicilianLemma .
  ?italianLexEntry vartrans:translatableAs ?sicLexEntry ;
                   ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .
  ?italianLemma dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/lemma/LemmaBank> ;
                ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord .

  # Exclude 'mandria' itself
  FILTER(STR(?italianWord) != "mandria")
}
ORDER BY ?italianWord

PREFIX lexinfo: <http://www.lexinfo.net/ontology/3.0/lexinfo#>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?coHyponymWr
WHERE {
  SERVICE <https://klab.ilc.cnr.it/graphdb-compl-it/> {
    # Find 'novelliere' and its senses
    ?word ontolex:canonicalForm [ ontolex:writtenRep ?wr ] ;
          ontolex:sense ?sense .
    FILTER(STR(?wr) = "novelliere")

    # Find hypernyms of 'novelliere':
    # ?sense lexinfo:hyponym ?hypernymSense means ?sense is more specific than ?hypernymSense
    ?sense lexinfo:hyponym ?hypernymSense .

    # Find co-hyponyms: other words that are also hyponyms of the same hypernym
    # ?hypernymSense lexinfo:hypernym ?coHyponymSense means ?coHyponymSense is more specific than ?hypernymSense
    ?hypernymSense lexinfo:hypernym ?coHyponymSense .

    # Get co-hyponym words and their written forms
    ?coHyponymWord ontolex:sense ?coHyponymSense ;
                   ontolex:canonicalForm [ ontolex:writtenRep ?coHyponymWr ] .

    # Exclude 'novelliere' itself
    FILTER(?coHyponymWord != ?word)
  }
}

PREFIX lexinfo: <http://www.lexinfo.net/ontology/3.0/lexinfo#>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?otherWordWr ?sharedPart
WHERE {
  SERVICE <https://klab.ilc.cnr.it/graphdb-compl-it/> {
    # Find 'insalata' and its senses
    ?insalata ontolex:canonicalForm [ ontolex:writtenRep ?insalataWr ] ;
              ontolex:sense ?insalataSense .
    FILTER(STR(?insalataWr) = "insalata")

    # Find parts (meronyms) of 'insalata':
    # ?partSense lexinfo:partMeronym ?insalataSense => ?partSense is a part of ?insalataSense
    ?partSense lexinfo:partMeronym ?insalataSense .

    # Get the shared part's written representation
    ?partWord ontolex:sense ?partSense ;
              ontolex:canonicalForm [ ontolex:writtenRep ?sharedPart ] .

    # Find other words that also have that same part sense as a meronym
    ?partSense lexinfo:partMeronym ?otherSense .
    ?otherWord ontolex:sense ?otherSense ;
               ontolex:canonicalForm [ ontolex:writtenRep ?otherWordWr ] .

    # Exclude 'insalata' itself
    FILTER(STR(?otherWordWr) != "insalata")
  }
}
ORDER BY ?sharedPart ?otherWordWr

PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?otherSicilianWord
WHERE {
  # Step 1: Find the Sicilian lemma 'arrùmpiri'
  ?arrumpiriLemma dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/DialettoSiciliano/lemma/LemmaBank> ;
                  ontolex:writtenRep ?arrumpiriWord .
  FILTER(STR(?arrumpiriWord) = "arrùmpiri")

  # Step 2: Sicilian lexical entry for 'arrùmpiri'
  ?arrumpiriLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?arrumpiriLemma .

  # Step 3: Find Italian entries that translate TO 'arrùmpiri'
  ?italianLexEntry vartrans:translatableAs ?arrumpiriLexEntry ;
                   ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .

  # Step 4: Find OTHER Sicilian lemmas that also translate those same Italian words
  ?otherItalianLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma ;
                        vartrans:translatableAs ?otherSicilianLexEntry .
  ?otherSicilianLexEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?otherSicilianLemma .
  ?otherSicilianLemma dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/DialettoSiciliano/lemma/LemmaBank> ;
                      ontolex:writtenRep ?otherSicilianWord .

  # Exclude 'arrùmpiri' itself
  FILTER(?otherSicilianLemma != ?arrumpiriLemma)
}

PREFIX complit: <http://klab/lexicon/vocabulary/compl-it#>
PREFIX lexinfo: <http://www.lexinfo.net/ontology/3.0/lexinfo#>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>

SELECT ?semanticType (COUNT(DISTINCT ?hyponymWord) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  SERVICE <https://klab.ilc.cnr.it/graphdb-compl-it/> {
    # Find 'libro' and its sense
    ?word ontolex:canonicalForm [ ontolex:writtenRep ?wr ] ;
          ontolex:sense ?sense .
    FILTER(STR(?wr) = "libro")

    # Find hyponyms: libro's sense is a hypernym of (more general than) the hyponym senses
    ?sense lexinfo:hypernym ?hyponymSense .

    # Get the hyponym words
    ?hyponymWord ontolex:sense ?hyponymSense .

    # Get the SIMPLE semantic type for each hyponym sense
    ?hyponymSense complit:hasSemanticType ?semanticType .
  }
}
GROUP BY ?semanticType
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?lemma ?wr1 ?wr2
WHERE {
  ?lemma dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/DialettoSiciliano/lemma/LemmaBank> .
  ?lemma ontolex:writtenRep ?wr1, ?wr2 .
  FILTER(?wr1 != ?wr2)
  FILTER(REGEX(STR(?wr1), "^d", "i"))
  FILTER(REGEX(STR(?wr2), "^r", "i"))
  FILTER(SUBSTR(STR(?wr1), 2) = SUBSTR(STR(?wr2), 2))
}
